statement: Partition split snapshot batching preserves all A1-v9 routing/capacity semantics while consuming rows and columns only through bounded dense own-data arrays and module-captured collection intrinsics: hostile iterators, sparse/inherited/accessor slots, Proxy rows/arrays, and post-load collection-method mutation cannot drop, synthesize or reorder snapshot rows; grouping and parameter construction remain deterministic and exact.

constraints.statement: Supersedes sealed partition-key-ordering-owner-completion-v9 after the newer category-complete Copilot PR #95 review rejected exact v9 head 885d5834de0640f95faad1d7868dd2ae8615f377: routeSplitSnapshotBatch used live Array.prototype.push plus iterator/map/flatMap/join/slice collection semantics, so post-load intrinsic mutation or hostile row arrays could silently drop snapshot rows. Preserve v9 predicate/evidence unchanged.

routeSplitSnapshotBatch accepts only canonical dense own-data arrays for rows and columns. Proxy arrays, sparse/inherited/accessor numeric slots and Proxy row records fail closed before traps or dispatch.

Snapshot grouping/batching does not consult mutable Array.prototype push/join/slice/map/flatMap/Symbol.iterator after module load. Required collection intrinsics are captured or avoided; internal Map access is likewise captured but is not globally mutated inside TAP because the test harness itself depends on Map.

Every admitted snapshot row appears exactly once in one routed child batch unless descriptor-epoch refusal stops dispatch. Mutating collection intrinsics cannot turn a nonempty input into successful empty dispatch.

Preserve v9 1023+1 reason capacity, 1024 partition-ID retention, proxy-safe live split metadata ingress, captured RegExp.exec, KeyRangeManager primitive-ID evaluation, and all v8/v7 ordering/table-ID/row-field/intrinsic semantics.

The exact rejected v9 candidate must be right-reason red for a hostile snapshot-row iterator in the focused TAP witness and for post-load Array.prototype.push mutation in the standalone closure probe; the v10 candidate must keep exact grouping/SQL/params under those controls and reject Proxy/sparse row arrays without traps.
Existing KeyRangeManager Array.from/map/sort intrinsic hardening remains a separate owner follow-up; v10 changes only snapshot split-routing collection ownership.
Persisted key type metadata, exact large-integer boundary representation, parser/bind precision, encoding migration and old-boundary revalidation remain A2.
Any v10 source candidate requires category-complete independent verification newer than its last attempt, covering both sealed verificationTemplates and exact candidate fingerprints.
No Raft runtime, consensus transport, lifecycle, membership or formation behavior changes.
